summary: The MTO contains multiple high-impact issues: missing rating, piping class, and end connection for all ball valves; duplicate entries for same size/type; and inconsistent or missing material descriptions. These gaps reduce procurement reliability and traceability.

comments.reason: Pressure rating is essential for valve selection and procurement.
comments.evidence_needed: P&ID symbol, legend, or valve datasheet specifying rating.

comments.reason: Piping class ensures compatibility with system design and materials.
comments.evidence_needed: P&ID, line list, or project legend showing class.

comments.reason: End connection (e.g., threaded, flanged, welded) is critical for installation.
